near_definition: Casefold, collapse whitespace, retain symbols; character 5-gram Jaccard >= 0.8; exclude normalized exact questions.
interval_method: Bonferroni difference of two 97.5% exact marginal Clopper-Pearson intervals; at least 95% unconditional coverage under iid questions
limitations: Lexical matches include shared templates/passages, not just repeated questions.
Base-model pretraining exposure and semantic paraphrases are not audited.
Original score files identify questions only by source and answer; order is assumed after that validation.
Per-question tests do not quantify training-seed uncertainty or shared-passage dependence.
